exposure: Ad libitum oral intake during labor
Nothing by mouth except ice chips during labor
outcome: Neonatal need for higher level of care
cohort: 2,784 women admitted to a suburban community hospital for labor
finding: Allowing women ad libitum oral intake during labor did not increase adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes compared to restricting intake to ice chips.
mod_finding: The group permitted nothing by mouth was significantly more likely to have unplanned cesarean section births than the group permitted ad lib oral intake.
